How it works

From your site to a shelf nearby

Three steps, whichever side you're on. Use the switch at the top to see the other side.

    The deal

    Both sides come out ahead

    Web-only brands get a place where people can touch the product. Shops get new, curated inventory and a share of the sales without buying stock up front.

    For shops

    • A cut of every sale you sendShoppers buy with your shelf's code and the commission is credited to you.
    • More reasons to walk inNew local and indie brands your regulars haven't seen yet.
    • Nothing to buy or restockBrands supply display units. Stock stays with them and ships from them.

    For online brands

    • A storefront without a leaseShow your product in shops your customers already visit.
    • Sales stay on your siteShelf cards send people to your store with a code, so you keep the customer and the data.
    • Pay only when it worksThe shop's share comes out of sales it actually drives.
    On the shelf

    Real shops, real products

    Brickline partners range from clothing boutiques to cafés and workshops. Each one gives a little shelf, rack or counter space to brands that sell online.

    Shelf cards

    The card is the checkout

    Each product on a Brickline shelf sits next to a stack of cards. The shopper takes one home and buys online when they're ready. The code on the card tells us which shelf made the sale.

    In the shop
    Pick it up. Try the product, take a card.
    At home
    Go to the link, enter the code. The shopper gets 10% off.
    After
    The brand ships it free. The shop's share is credited to the shop.
